newsitem.title: USA: Florida approves cut in Allstate car rates.
newsitem.headline: Florida approves cut in Allstate car rates.

text.p: Allstate Corp will cut its average car-insurance rates in Florida by slightly less than one percent, the state's Insurance Department said on Tuesday.

Florida Insurance Commissioner Bill Nelson said in a statement that the reduction, effective on April 14 for new customers and on May 12 for repeat customers, affects some 1.1 million car owners. Savings for customers should amount to about $4 million, Nelson said.
Insurance Department officials were not immediately available for comment.
